svg.title: The Sedov solution
svg.desc: Profiles of the Sedov solution for Gamma = 5/3 against r/r_sh, from 0 to 1.25. The pressure p/p_2, in black, is about 0.31 at the centre, rises slowly and then steeply to 1 at the shock. The velocity v/v_2, in blue, grows almost linearly from 0 at the centre to 1 at the shock. The density rho/rho_2, in red, is close to zero in most of the interior and rises steeply to 1 just behind the shock; outside the shock it drops to rho_1/rho_2 = 1/4.

g.font-family: 'Latin Modern Math', 'STIX Two Math', 'Cambria Math', serif
